Mnemonic: All People Seem To Need Data Processing.

Client-server: Netflix, Google. Central control, easier backup, but server overload is a risk.

P2P: BitTorrent. No central server, hard to take down, but no central authority.
Bandwidth = how much data per second. Latency = how long one packet takes. Streaming wants high bandwidth; gaming wants low latency.
